attribution.title: GafleiRavineRock-RotterPlaque RomanDeckert30122024-02
attribution.author: RomanDeckert
attribution.credit: Own work
attribution.description: A plaque commemorating the Jewish couple Alfred and Gertrud Rotter in a ravine underneath Gaflei in the principality of Liechtenstein. The mirror, which was created by Liechtensteiner artist Hansjörg Quaderer and set up in 2002, bears the inscription: "An diesem Ort wurde am 5. April 1933 das jüdische Ehepaar Alfred und Gertrud Schaie (Rotter) von Liechtensteiner und Deutschen Nationalsozialisten in den Tod getrieben." (On April 5, 1933, the Jewish couple Alfred and Gertrud Schaie (Rotter) were driven to their deaths at this place by Liechtensteiner and German Nazis.)
